scientific_question: On the exact RK20 train/dev/test/sequence-OOD assignments, does the four-seed all-channel RiboKinetic function model outperform a train-only Boel author-structure model, and does that author model outperform the previous ridge_all and HistGB full-proxy controls?
observed_phenomenon: RK20 did not establish a stable all-channel increment over ridge_all or HistGB, but those controls did not include the complete Boel author model. RK24 supported the author model on a different protein-OOD split, so its metrics cannot be transferred to the RK20 partition.
falsifiable_hypothesis: The mean-per-seed all-channel model is superior to the author model on sequence-OOD Spearman and cluster-balanced MSE, while the author model is superior to both previous full-proxy controls on the same two endpoints.
scope: A strong-comparator addendum on already observed cross-protein, nonsynonymous Boel ordinal-expression data. It is not fixed-protein synonymous evidence, untouched confirmation, causal mechanism evidence, generator training, or external SOTA.

author_model.feature_contract: Exactly the 72 RK24 author features: source_Gz48v, I_62, aH, aH2, gH2, u3H, L_knt, Linv_knt, rAA, dAUA, 60 non-ATG codon frequencies, s7_16, and s17_32.
author_model.single_codon_slopes: Refit 61 unregularized binary E5-versus-E0 logistic models on RK20 train extremes only; freeze raw-frequency slopes for regional features.
author_model.final_model: Multinomial logistic expected score on all RK20 train rows, fixed L2=0.01 and max_iter=4000.
author_model.implementation: Import the frozen RK24 author_feature_names, feature_matrix, and fit_binary_logistic definitions; use the same RK07 multinomial logistic implementation.

estimand: Mean of four per-seed left-minus-right effects. Deterministic author/ridge/HistGB predictions are repeated for each seed; no prediction averaging or ensemble claim.

statistics.bootstrap: Hierarchical resampling of operational protein clusters and four training seeds independently with replacement, using identical sampled clusters and seeds for all models.
statistics.interval: two-sided percentile 95% CI on the raw left-minus-right delta
statistics.pvalue: two-sided sign-tail probability on the benefit scale
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across exactly six sequence-OOD comparison-by-endpoint tests
statistics.spearman_benefit: left minus right; support requires delta>0 and CI lower bound>0
statistics.mse_benefit: right minus left on the benefit scale; raw delta remains left minus right and support requires delta<0 and CI upper bound<0

pass_rules.individual_endpoint: Required raw-delta direction, corresponding 95% CI entirely on the beneficial side of zero, and Holm-adjusted p<0.05.
pass_rules.author_reference_pass: All four author_vs_ridge_all and author_vs_histgb_all endpoints pass.
pass_rules.failed_or_mixed_result: Retain all dev/test/sequence-OOD metrics and the failed gate; do not remove a comparator, seed, endpoint, or partition.

dev_role: Fit on train and compute train/dev only. Independent dev refit, prediction comparison, metric recomputation, and hash binding are mandatory before sequence-OOD. Dev effect direction does not decide whether OOD is reported and is not used to change the model or protocol.
test_role: Descriptive only after dev independent verification; already observed in RK08/RK20 and not globally untouched.
sequence_ood_role: One confirmation-gated evaluation after dev independent verification. This is a new author-model readout on an already observed partition, not untouched confirmation.

decision.reason: The prior velocity and fixed-protein mechanism requirements remain unresolved and this cross-protein nonsynonymous partition is not independent functional-untouched evidence.

cost_contract.ribokinetic_predictions: Reuse four hash-frozen RK20 all-channel prediction files; do not relabel reuse as new training.

prohibited_claims: No use of RK24 fitted coefficients or published full-data coefficients on the RK20 split.
No direct comparison of metrics calculated on different split assignments.
No claim of fixed-protein synonymous causality, velocity, decay, complete spatial coupling, functional-untouched confirmation, or generator authorization.
No claim of CodonFlow-RK generation superiority, complete external SOTA, or controlled time-matched superiority.
